title: Fixed String Console and Three Pedal Linkage Steel Guitar
description: One newly authored whole static pedal-steel-style string-console instrument. A long narrow solid console with deep front and rear aprons has a full raised string deck, a genuinely open central tuner-head pocket at one end and ten separate fixed bridge fingers on a common transverse axle at the other. Ten continuous strings span individual tuner posts, a full nut and bridge; a separate pickup and fixed controls complete the top. Four outward-sloping legs terminate in finite ground feet. A complete low front pedal bar joins the front legs, carries three thick projecting foot pedals and three full vertical rods ending in separately modeled under-console crank arms. Two additional fixed knee-lever appearances hang below the console. All geometry is new: not an electric guitar laid on a stand or a zither with more strings; the legged console, end hardware and entire pedal-to-underframe layout define the complete object. Four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and horizontal-envelope-centred ground origin. One prop and zero scenes. Static illustrative exterior only; string tension, sound, tuning, pitch-change mechanism, pedal or knee movement, electrical internals, playing ergonomics and manufacture are not verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
